lista.limiteAtingido: You have reached the limit of {{maximo}} agents. This limit comes from Bitrix, which allows at most {{maximo}} bots per application — it does not change by plan. Delete an agent to create another.
lista.vazio: No agents yet. Create the first one to get started.

criar.tipoAjuda: Type and style define how the agent runs the conversation. You can change both later on the settings screen.
criar.camposObrigatorios: Fill in every field to create the agent.

campos.nomeAjuda: This is the name the agent introduces itself with in the conversation.
campos.comportamentoAjuda: Instructions on how the agent should act: tone, what it may promise, when to hand over to a human.

perfil.subtitulo: This data lives in GPT Maker and defines how the agent behaves.
perfil.indisponivel: GPT Maker did not respond, so the profile could not be loaded. Saving now would wipe the fields that were not read — reload the page before editing.

horario.subtitulo: Rule applied before the agent is triggered. It does not exist in GPT Maker.
horario.inverterLigado: The agent answers OUTSIDE the configured hours and stays silent within them.
horario.inverterDesligado: The agent answers WITHIN the configured hours and stays silent outside them.
horario.sairComColaborador: Leave the conversation when a human agent joins

bot.semVinculo: No bot linked. Without a bot, the agent does not receive messages from open channels.
bot.comVinculo: Bound to bot {{nome}} (#{{botId}}) in this portal.
bot.desvinculado: Bot unbound. It stays in the portal.
bot.nenhumDisponivel: Every portal bot is already bound to another agent. Create a new bot to use here.
bot.erroCarregar: Could not load the portal bots.

excluir.confirmar: Delete the agent "{{nome}}"? This removes it from GPT Maker.

secoes.perfilDescricao: How the agent introduces itself and what it knows about its job.
secoes.atendimentoDescricao: When the agent answers and which portal bot it answers through.
